definition: Observed state-aligned matched-device movements: each device present in two consecutive 15-minute bins contributes one directed transition from its previous representative cell to its current representative cell. Counts are aggregate observations, not model-implied flows.
displayNote: Observed movements · strongest flows. All positive off-diagonal movements are available; the map may highlight a subset for readability.
stateComparisonNote: Movements are reconstructed from raw matched-device records. The displayed population states use median-denoised counts; these flows are not asserted to sum exactly to changes in those states. Entrants and exits also contribute to raw node balance. Same-cell retention is excluded from the flow map.
sortOrder: Descending count, then ascending origin and destination indices
